build: gpu/build/y2s90-final/payload/Nord2Metal.bundle (merge_final.sh: thumbfix5 + merge/series 10-usecount 20-photosperf 30-gamepipe 40-final, src/redwoodmetal.m 54d2fac9; libredwoodair rebuilt byte-identical 6df1af45, not installed)
library: current library accepted: libmerge6 (fe59bddb...), also libmerge5/4/3/2/1, thumbrc, y2s47; the library is not touched
